import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline

# Set working directories
TRAIN_FILE = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_FILE = "./input/test.csv"
SUBMISSION_FILE = "./submission/submission.csv"

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_FILE)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_FILE)
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Prepare features (all columns except Id and Cover_Type)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
X_train = train_df[feature_cols]
y_train = train_df["Cover_Type"]
test_features = test_df[feature_cols]

print(f"Training samples: {len(X_train)}")
print(f"Features: {len(feature_cols)}")
print(f"Target class distribution:\n{y_train.value_counts()}")

# Check column types
categorical_cols = []
numerical_cols = []
for col in feature_cols:
    if X_train[col].dtype == "object" or X_train[col].dtype.name == "category":
        categorical_cols.append(col)
    else:
        numerical_cols.append(col)

print(f"Categorical columns: {len(categorical_cols)}")
print(f"Numerical columns: {len(numerical_cols)}")

# Build preprocessing pipeline with proper handling
preprocess = ColumnTransformer(
    transformers=[
        (
            "cat",
            OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore", sparse_output=False),
            categorical_cols,
        ),
        ("num", StandardScaler(), numerical_cols),
    ]
)

# Train on full dataset for preprocessing consistency
preprocess.fit(X_train)

# Split for validation (never use validation data for final model fitting)
X_train_full, X_val, y_train_full, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

print(f"\nValidation set size: {len(X_val)}")
print(f"Train set size: {len(X_train_full)}")

# Create LightGBM pipeline
model_pipeline = Pipeline(
    [
        ("preprocess", preprocess),
        (
            "model",
            lgb.LGBMClassifier(
                n_estimators=5000,
                learning_rate=0.03,
                max_depth=7,
                min_child_samples=20,
                num_leaves=63,
                reg_alpha=0.1,
                reg_lambda=0.1,
                bagging_fraction=0.8,
                bagging_freq=5,
                feature_fraction=0.8,
                verbose=-1,
                random_state=42,
                n_jobs=-1,
                force_col_wise=True,
            ),
        ),
    ]
)

# Fit pipeline on training data only
model_pipeline.fit(X_train_full, y_train_full)

# Evaluate on held-out validation set (no refitting)
val_predictions = model_pipeline.predict(X_val)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_predictions)
print(f"\nValidation Accuracy (Hold-Out): {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
test_predictions = model_pipeline.predict(test_features)

# Format submission file
submission_data = {
    "Id": test_df["Id"].astype(str).tolist(),
    "Cover_Type": test_predictions.astype(int).tolist(),
}
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(submission_data)
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_FILE, index=False)

print("\nSubmission saved to:", SUBMISSION_FILE)
print(f"Final Validation Metric: {val_accuracy:.4f}")
